Triage (2026-09-20T15:43Z): lands in `domain:spec` · `priority:p1` · type `Task`.

**Lane and grade both come from the anchor, ⛔ not from fresh judgement.** objectstack#17667 — the `/packages` door, the SAME declared-but-never-read `limit`/`cursor` shape this card reports on three siblings — is `domain:spec` `priority:p1`, type `Task`. 同形同判: three more doors of one defect do not become a smaller defect. ⇒ `p1`, `Task`, spec lane.

**Why that grade is right on its own terms too.** 北极星「优先级」4's second half: 「声明了的对象、动作、agent / tool / skill 元数据在运行时兑现,MCP 面暴露的就是应用真能做的」. A declared-schema reader — an SDK, codegen, or an **AI client**, which is the reader this platform is built for — is *entitled* to believe an unparameterised list is capped. It is not capped at all: it asks for one row and is handed the whole table beside a `hasMore: false` that agrees with the lie. ⭐ `.default(20)` on `ListExportJobsRequestSchema` is the same trap `.default(50)` was on `/packages`, and a materialised default is worse than a bare optional: it makes the false cap look deliberate.

⭐ The automation door is the sharpest of the three because it convicts itself: `GET /automation/:name/runs` VALIDATES `cursor` at the boundary and then returns `{ runs, hasMore: false }`, its own comment recording that 「today's engine ignores the option entirely」. Performing the ceremony of accepting a pagination parameter and then discarding it is 声明 ≠ 兑现 with the evidence written next to it.

## ⚠️ How this lands — the 阶段姿态 governs, and it says ⛔ NOT one card per key

`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 阶段姿态, verbatim: 「声明了但不兑现的键按发布批量退役,**不一键一卡**」.

⇒ this card is a CENSUS of three doors, ⛔ not three retirement cards and ⛔ not a request for three PRs. The claimant folds these keys into the release's retirement batch alongside whatever objectstack#17667 retires, in one act, and ⛔ does not open a card per door. If the batch for this release has already closed, say so on this card and name the next one — ⛔ do not fall back to one-card-per-key because the batch was missed.

⚠️ **`.default(20)` needs a decision the other two do not.** Removing a bare optional key is a narrowing; removing a key that materialises a value changes what an existing caller's parsed object contains. The claimant states which it is doing and whether anything reads the materialised `20` today, ⛔ before the batch is written.

Size/model suggestion: S as part of the batch; ⛔ do not size it standalone.
